# M05-auth-failure: Not signed in: the model call fails (x-assumed shapes), the run ends with run.terminal.failed and its reason, and the reason is the final stderr line (changelog 1.4.0); exit 1. Classified auth_required.
# Needs a Muse that is not signed in: an --env-file without META_API_KEY on a machine whose Muse has no stored sign-in. Never run `muse logout` on the everyday sign-in for this; keep synthesized otherwise.
# A fresh git-init copy of tests/fixtures/sandboxes/ts-small as <sandbox>; Muse signs in with the key, never the everyday sign-in.
# <fixture Muse home> is an isolated folder that stands in for the home (never the everyday one): its .config/muse is the profile recorded.
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --muse --muse-home "<fixture Muse home>" --bin "<the muse executable>" --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures/muse/exec/M05-auth-failure --id M05 --slug auth-failure --cli-version <muse --version> --timing off --env-file "<a file with META_API_KEY=...>" --pass-file tests/fixtures/muse/recipes/M05-auth-failure/pass.json --timeout 900000 -- exec --json --prompt-file "<repo>/tests/fixtures/muse/recipes/M05-auth-failure/prompt.md" --trust-workspace --disable-approval --sandbox-network restricted
